policy: Only genuinely absent dedicated Activity-ending visuals are listed. Existing project-owned media is reused only when it does not imply a forbidden career, School path, faction, or mechanical requirement.

assets.desired: Cross-region survey table or atlas scene combining multiple Activity regions without implying a single career.
assets.reuseLimit: Representative route image only; it must not be read as a Forest-only requirement.

assets.desired: Field archive scene with labeled secured samples, notes, cases, and ritual/research records.
assets.reuseLimit: Neutral city-return image only; it does not depict the archive itself.

assets.desired: Multi-contact expedition network scene linking distinct regional contacts without assigning a single career or faction.
